descriptionChirho: Qal: to be attached to, to love, to set one's desire or affection upon someone or something. All occurrences share the core meaning of deep emotional attachment or longing -- the splits by English gloss ('desired', 'delighted', 'loved', 'longs', 'desire') reflect contextual translation choices rather than genuinely distinct senses. Shechem's soul was attached to Dinah and he 'longed for' her (Gen 34:8); the LORD 'desired' or 'set his love upon' Israel's fathers (Deut 7:7; 10:15); Solomon 'desired' to build various projects (1 Kgs 9:19; 2 Chr 8:6); 'because he has set his love upon me' says the LORD in Psalm 91:14; 'you have loved my soul from the pit of destruction' (Isa 38:17); and 'if you desire her' regarding a captive woman (Deut 21:11). Multilingual glosses converge: arb raghiba/ta'allaqa/tashtahiha, deu desired/sehnt-sich/geliebt, hin chaha/lagai/lipTa, kor gippeohasyeossda/wonhada/samoha, spa se-agrado/deseo/se-ha-apegado.
